title: Amenity bookings
structure: The topbar holds the <h1> "Amenity bookings" then a .top-right containing one .btn-outline-sm (gear SVG) reading "Manage amenities" — an outline button, not the primary blue used on screen 17. The .content block holds three siblings in order. (1) .subnav with three .subnav-item divs: "Maintenance", "Amenities" carrying .active, "Vendors". (2) .filter-row with five .f-chip divs: "All amenities" with .active, "Gazebo", "Club House", "Community Centre", then a fifth chip pushed right by inline style margin-left:auto;background:var(--amber-100);color:var(--amber-700); reading "1 pending approval" (amber here, versus the red overdue chip on screen 17). (3) <table class="data-table"> with a thead row of six <th>: Amenity, Booked by, Date & time, Deposit, Status, and an empty sixth th for row actions. tbody holds four <tr> of six <td> each. The first cell of every row is a .amen-cell flex wrapper containing a .amen-icon square (34px, navy-100, radius 10) with an inline SVG, followed by the bare amenity name text. Row 1: Gazebo (gazebo/umbrella SVG), "Andrea Fletcher — Lot 47", "Sat, Sep 20 · 11:00 AM–1:00 PM", "$5,000 held", .status-badge.confirmed "Confirmed", .text-link-sm "View". Row 2: Club House (house SVG), "Sonia Campbell — Lot 88", "Sun, Sep 21 · 3:00 PM–7:00 PM", "$6,000 — awaiting payment", .status-badge.pending "Pending", and instead of a link a .row-actions flex holding two 28px .icon-btn: .approve (green-100 fill, check-polyline SVG) then .reject (red-100 fill, X SVG). Row 3: Community Centre (pavilion SVG), "Keith Walters — Lot 63", "Sat, Sep 27 · 6:00 PM–10:00 PM", "$10,000 held", .status-badge.confirmed "Confirmed", .text-link-sm "View". Row 4: Gazebo again, "Rachel Bennett — Lot 3", "Aug 15 (past)", "$5,000 refunded Aug 18", .status-badge.completed "Completed", .text-link-sm "View".
table_headers: Amenity | Booked by | Date & time | Deposit | Status | (empty 6th header for row actions)
controls: Approve (green check icon-btn, Club House / Sonia Campbell)
Reject (red X icon-btn, Club House / Sonia Campbell)
View (row link, Community Centre / Keith Walters)
domain_needs: amenity.name — "Gazebo", "Club House", "Community Centre" (the same three drive the filter chips; Pool Deck exists on screen 20 but has no bookings here)
amenity.icon_key — each row draws a distinct SVG per amenity, so the icon is a stored per-amenity key, not derived from the name

booking.resident_name and booking.unit_label — rendered as name + " — " + unit: "Andrea Fletcher — Lot 47", "Sonia Campbell — Lot 88", "Keith Walters — Lot 63", "Rachel Bennett — Lot 3" (em-dash with spaces; unit label is "Lot N" with no zero padding)
booking.booking_date — upcoming bookings render "Sat, Sep 20", "Sun, Sep 21", "Sat, Sep 27" (format "ddd, MMM D", weekday abbreviated, no year)
booking.start_time / booking.end_time — rendered after the date with " · " then a range joined by an en-dash and no spaces: "11:00 AM–1:00 PM", "3:00 PM–7:00 PM", "6:00 PM–10:00 PM"
booking date rendering for past bookings is DERIVED — when booking_date < today the cell collapses to "Aug 15 (past)": no weekday, no time range, plus the literal suffix " (past)"
booking.deposit_amount — 5000, 6000, 10000; formatted with a bare "$" prefix and thousands comma (no J$ prefix on this board)
booking.deposit_state — enum {held, awaiting payment, refunded}; rendered as amount + " held", amount + " — awaiting payment" (em-dash), amount + " refunded " + refund date
booking.deposit_refunded_on — "Aug 18" on the completed Gazebo booking (format "MMM D", 3 days after the Aug 15 event date)
booking.status — enum {Confirmed, Pending, Completed}; drives .status-badge modifier .confirmed (green) / .pending (amber) / .completed (green, shared styling with confirmed)
booking row actions are DERIVED from status — Pending renders the .row-actions approve/reject icon pair; every other status renders a single .text-link-sm "View"
booking list sort order — upcoming bookings ascending by date (Sep 20, Sep 21, Sep 27) then past bookings last (Aug 15), i.e. status/temporal grouping then date, not a plain date sort
filter.amenity — chip set {All amenities, Gazebo, Club House, Community Centre} with "All amenities" default active; the chip list is generated from bookable amenities
kpi/chip.pending_approval = 1 — DERIVED count of bookings with status = Pending, rendered "1 pending approval" in an amber chip
booking.approved_by / approved_at — implied by the approve action on a Pending booking
booking.rejected_reason — implied by the reject action

link from booking to amenity fee/deposit schedule — the deposit shown per row equals amenity.deposit_amount on screen 20 (Gazebo 5,000 / Club House 6,000 / Community Centre 10,000), so deposit_amount is copied onto the booking at creation time rather than read live
accounting_notes: No account codes, debit/credit columns, trial balance, ageing bucket or running balance are drawn on this screen — the only ledger-bearing column is "Deposit". Transcribe exactly: "$5,000 held" (Gazebo, Andrea Fletcher — Lot 47, Confirmed), "$6,000 — awaiting payment" (Club House, Sonia Campbell — Lot 88, Pending), "$10,000 held" (Community Centre, Keith Walters — Lot 63, Confirmed), "$5,000 refunded Aug 18" (Gazebo, Rachel Bennett — Lot 3, Completed). Currency is written with a bare "$" and comma thousands separator, with NO decimal places and NO J$ prefix, unlike the ledger boards. Three distinct deposit states must each map to a posting: (a) "held" — cash received from the resident and carried as a refundable liability, so Dr Cash/Bank, Cr Amenity Deposits Held (a liability control account); the held balance implied by this screen is 5,000 + 10,000 = 15,000, which is a DERIVED sum of the two Confirmed rows and is not itself printed anywhere on the board. (b) "awaiting payment" — the $6,000 is a quoted/expected deposit only, with no cash movement yet; it must NOT be posted to the deposits-held liability or it will overstate the control account by 6,000. It is at most a receivable raised against the resident's unit ledger, and the booking sits at status Pending until it clears. (c) "refunded Aug 18" — the reversal of a previously held deposit: Dr Amenity Deposits Held 5,000, Cr Cash/Bank 5,000, dated Aug 18, three days after the Aug 15 event date; the row's status becomes Completed and the deposit no longer forms part of the held balance. Each deposit figure ties one-for-one to amenity.deposit_amount on screen 20 (Gazebo $5,000, Club House $6,000, Community Centre $10,000), so the deposit control account per amenity reconciles as: sum of deposits held = count of confirmed bookings × that amenity's configured deposit. Note the booking fee (a real revenue item, $3,000 / $4,500 / $8,000 on screen 20) is NOT shown in this Deposit column at all — fee revenue and refundable deposit are separate postings and must not be conflated in one figure.
